crossRefs.note: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but…

translations.web: “ ‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.
translations.bsb: Any saddle on which the man with the discharge rides will be unclean.
translations.kjv: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.
translations.asv: And what saddle soever he that hath the issue rideth upon shall be unclean.
